g.data-summary: what each dot shape's code path is, contender by contender
g.text: ▾ Code paths — what each dot shape's code path is, contender by contender

svg.text: BLAKE3 servil · One message per call · scalar kernel c1, one call from the start: Inputs of one chunk (1 KiB) or less run every block, the root compression included, in one call
to the integer-only kernel, with the state in registers throughout.
BLAKE3 servil · One message per call · integer + NEON hybrid kernels from 1025 B: Above one chunk the tree is hashed several chunks at a time, up to sixteen per call on this
platform; the hybrid kernels run scalar chunks on the integer units beside NEON chunks (k10: two scalar beside eight NEON), so both stay busy.
BLAKE3 servil · Many 64-byte messages per call · scalar kernel c1, one message per call from the start: A single message runs the same one-call kernel as hash().
BLAKE3 servil · Many 64-byte messages per call · NEON hybrid parent kernels p2-p9 from 128 B: Two or more one-block messages are compressed together on the NEON hybrid kernels, up
to eight lanes beside a scalar lane per call; on SME2 this remains the path for the messages left over below a group of sixteen.
BLAKE3 servil · One message, streamed in 64 KiB pieces · scalar kernel c1, one call from the start: Inputs of one chunk (1 KiB) or less run every block, the root compression
included, in one call to the integer-only kernel, with the state in registers throughout.
BLAKE3 servil · One message, streamed in 64 KiB pieces · integer + NEON hybrid kernels from 1025 B: Above one chunk the tree is hashed several chunks at a time, up to sixteen per
call on this platform; the hybrid kernels run scalar chunks on the integer units beside NEON chunks (k10: two scalar beside eight NEON), so both stay busy.
BLAKE3 servil mt · One message per call · scalar kernel c1, one call from the start: Inputs of one chunk (1 KiB) or less run every block, the root compression included, in one
call to the integer-only kernel, with the state in registers throughout.
BLAKE3 servil mt · One message per call · integer + NEON hybrid kernels from 1025 B: Above one chunk the tree is hashed several chunks at a time, up to sixteen per call on this
platform; the hybrid kernels run scalar chunks on the integer units beside NEON chunks (k10: two scalar beside eight NEON), so both stay busy.
BLAKE3 servil mt · One message per call · subtrees over threads from 64 KiB: From here calls may cut the input at subtree boundaries into pieces of 8 KiB to 128 KiB, shrinking
toward the end, that the calling thread and this crate's worker threads (one per CPU beyond the first) hash at once, each on the NEON hybrid kernels, which run at full speed on
every core at once; the caller merges the chaining values. Concurrent callers' pieces are served in turn; when callers already fill the CPUs, a new call hashes its input whole
BLAKE3 servil mt · Many 64-byte messages per call · scalar kernel c1, one message per call from the start: A single message runs the same one-call kernel as hash().
BLAKE3 servil mt · Many 64-byte messages per call · NEON hybrid parent kernels p2-p9 from 128 B: Two or more one-block messages are compressed together on the NEON hybrid kernels,
up to eight lanes beside a scalar lane per call; on SME2 this remains the path for the messages left over below a group of sixteen.
BLAKE3 servil mt · Many 64-byte messages per call · message ranges over threads from 64 KiB: From here a batch is cut into ranges of messages of 8 KiB to 128 KiB, shrinking toward
the end, that the calling thread and this crate's worker threads hash at once, each range on the NEON hybrid kernels, which run at full speed on every core at once. Concurrent
callers' ranges are served in turn; when callers already fill the CPUs, a new call hashes its batch whole on its own thread.
BLAKE3 servil mt · One message, streamed in 64 KiB pieces · scalar kernel c1, one call from the start: Inputs of one chunk (1 KiB) or less run every block, the root compression
included, in one call to the integer-only kernel, with the state in registers throughout.
BLAKE3 servil mt · One message, streamed in 64 KiB pieces · integer + NEON hybrid kernels from 1025 B: Above one chunk the tree is hashed several chunks at a time, up to sixteen
per call on this platform; the hybrid kernels run scalar chunks on the integer units beside NEON chunks (k10: two scalar beside eight NEON), so both stay busy.
BLAKE3 servil mt · One message, streamed in 64 KiB pieces · subtrees over threads from 64 KiB: From here calls may cut the input at subtree boundaries into pieces of 8 KiB to 128
KiB, shrinking toward the end, that the calling thread and this crate's worker threads (one per CPU beyond the first) hash at once, each on the NEON hybrid kernels, which run at
full speed on every core at once; the caller merges the chaining values. Concurrent callers' pieces are served in turn; when callers already fill the CPUs, a new call hashes its
input whole on its own thread.
SHA-256 · One message per call · sha2 aarch64_sha2 backend (ARMv8 SHA-256 instructions) from the start: One kernel at every size.
SHA-256 · Many 64-byte messages per call · sha2 aarch64_sha2 backend (ARMv8 SHA-256 instructions) · one 64 B message per call from the start: Every message is its own call of the
one-message entry point; the batch size changes nothing in the code path.
SHA-256 · One message, streamed in 64 KiB pieces · sha2 aarch64_sha2 backend (ARMv8 SHA-256 instructions) from the start: One kernel at every size.
SHA-256 ring · One message per call · sha256_block_data_order_hw (ARMv8 SHA-256 instructions, pipelined schedule) from the start: One kernel at every size.
SHA-256 ring · Many 64-byte messages per call · sha256_block_data_order_hw (ARMv8 SHA-256 instructions, pipelined schedule) · one 64 B message per call from the start: Every
message is its own call of the one-message entry point; the batch size changes nothing in the code path.
SHA-256 ring · One message, streamed in 64 KiB pieces · sha256_block_data_order_hw (ARMv8 SHA-256 instructions, pipelined schedule) from the start: One kernel at every size.
